tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Guideline for easy integration of Mitto SMS service.. Call this endpoint to send SMS sending request

From.description: Sender ID of the SMS message seen on the receivers phone

to.description: Phone number that you are sending SMS to

flash.description: When set to true it will send the message in Flash mode. (default: )

validity.description: Validity period of the SMS message in minutes. When not specified, the validity of a message defaults to 2,880 minutes (48 hours). (default: 2880)

pid.description: Protocol identifier. Must be consistent with the udh parameter value. When not specified, defaults to 0. (default: 0)

test.description: When set to true, the API call is in test mode (No actual SMS is delivered) and "test": true is returned in the response. For test calls, there is no id parameter in the response. When set to false, the API call is made in production mode. An actual SMS is delivered, and the id parameter is returned in the response. In addition to that, "test": true is also returned. When not specified (the default), the API call is made in production mode. The id parameter is returned in the response, but not the test parameter. Please also refer to Making Test API Calls. (default: )

type.description: Character set in which the message content will be encoded. If not specified, the default encoding (GSM) is used For Unicode, set type=Unicode. For Binary, set type=Binary. (default: )

reference.description: A customer reference. It is possible to set a different reference string for each message or tag multiple messages with the same string and group them together. Further details can be found at Delivery Reports and Adding Metadata to the Message. (default: )

This result provides the necessary target list for generating the negative sentiment alerts. Next, I will configure the SMS distribution tool to send these alerts to subscribers.

The scraping tool successfully retrieved news articles for the 10 bearish symbols identified in the previous step. This content provides the necessary details to populate the alert messages for the campaign. I will now proceed to configure the SMS distribution tool in test mode to send these updates.
